title: Create for twinks
description: A few Create recipes that helps with automation.
body:
Some recipes added for create that helps with more automation.

The create mod is needed to use thies recipes.

Reecipes added:
1. Tuff - 1 gravel and 100ml lava in a mixer.
2. Deepslate - 1 stone pressed 3 times.
3. Basalt - 1 blue ice and 200ml lava in a mixer.
4. Dripstone - 1 stone and 100ml water in a mixer.
